test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option which means the same as the underlined segment.

The boss wanted to __finish __the case before the arrival of the Inspection team.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e.** 'be over and done with'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Finish" **means to complete or conclude, similar to **"****be over and done with"** something, implying a task is fully completed.
 
• The context requires task completion before an event, aligning with the finality suggested by "be over and done with".
 
• The urgency of completing the task before the Inspection team's arrival matches the notion of wanting something to be "over and done with".

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'be over and done with'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2)** "be over one’s head"** indicates being overwhelmed, not finishing a task.
 
• Option 3) **"be over and over"** suggests repetition, not completion.
 
• Option 4) **"be over a barrel"** describes a disadvantageous situation, unrelated to task completion.
